[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Subset Mex** [CF 1406A · Subset Mex](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1406/A){rating="900"}

The two subsets compete for the same copies of each value. A value with two or more copies can appear on both sides; a value with only one copy can push at most one side's MEX past it. So the maximum sum is "$\operatorname{MEX}$ of values that appear at all" plus "$\operatorname{MEX}$ of values that appear at least twice" — one subset uses every present value, the other uses only doubly-present values.

[Solved in full in @sec-mex-p1-subset-mex.]{.card-link}

:::
